featured_reviews.review_text:
The trainers on the Cult Transform program are genuinely excellent — knowledgeable, supportive, and worth showing up for. This review is not about them.
My issue is with the front-desk staff member who handles late arrivals.
I have a demanding schedule, and I consistently make the effort to show up, even when it would be easier not to. On one occasion, I arrived a minute past the 5-minute cutoff, still putting on my shoes. I was told I should have scanned the QR code before wearing my shoes. I understand there's a policy. I don't understand why it needs to be enforced with zero discretion, in full view of an entire class, rather than stepped aside and handled quietly.
This isn't an isolated incident. This staff member has spoken to me rudely on multiple occasions, told me I "lack discipline," and instructed me to email Cult if I can't arrive on time. All for a one-minute delay from someone who keeps coming back despite a packed schedule.
The 5-minute rule exists. Discipline matters. But so does basic courtesy, privacy when raising an issue, and some recognition that a person showing up late is still a person who showed up.
A program this good deserves front-of-house staff who represent it the same way.

featured_reviews.name: Komal Auti
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a second-year engineering student, and my journey at the IGNITE Event Fashion Show was truly one of the most memorable experiences of my college life.
During the IGNITE event organized by our college, a fashion show was arranged, and I got the opportunity to participate in it. For our choreography, Kristina Ma’am and Pushpen Sir were appointed as our mentors. From 21st January to 31st January, we trained under their guidance, and the experience of working with them was absolutely fabulous. It was my first time participating in such a grand event, and throughout the journey, I felt myself growing more confident day by day.
Day 1
On the very first day, I had no prior experience and no clear idea about choreography or stage performance. However, once the practice began, Kristina Ma’am made everything feel comfortable. Slowly and steadily, she helped us build confidence. She is extremely calm, patient, and supportive. Even when we made mistakes repeatedly, she never scolded us. Instead, she focused on correcting us and teaching us again with the same dedication and positivity.
Day 2
On the second day, Ma’am helped everyone with costume practice as well. The practice sessions were continuous and intense, but neither Ma’am nor Sir ever showed tiredness. They practiced with us, put in equal effort, and stayed till late hours. Even while returning home late at night, they remained energetic and motivating, which inspired us even more.
Day 3
On the third day, I personally faced a bit of weakness and low confidence. Because of that, I sometimes forgot steps during practice. Kristina Ma’am noticed this and personally asked me if I was facing any problem. She encouraged me to share openly and assured me that we would work through it together. That support meant a lot to me. With every passing day, my confidence kept increasing. We practiced continuously for 4–5 hours, and since Ma’am and Sir practiced alongside us, the entire process felt enjoyable and motivating.
Day 4 & Day 5
During the last two days, several complications and challenges came up. However, Kristina Ma’am handled every situation very smartly and calmly. She encouraged us to stay focused and give our best despite the difficulties. Her motivation pushed us to practice with even more dedication and energy.
Day 6 – Final Day
The final day was truly the best and most exciting day. After so many days of hard work, our efforts were finally going to show results. Ma’am helped us with costumes, makeup, and overall presentation. Even when some costumes were not ready on time, she managed everything perfectly.
The most amazing part of the performance was the final dance, where we performed together with Sir and Ma’am. The performance was powerful, energetic, and truly a stage-breaking one. The result we had worked so hard for came out exactly the way we hoped.

This entire journey with the Dance and Fitness Team was more than just a performance—it was a lesson in confidence, discipline, teamwork, and dedication. I am extremely grateful to Kristina Ma’am and Pushpen Sir for their guidance, patience, and constant support.
This experience will always hold a special place in my heart and will remain one of the best memories of my college life.

When I started, I had no prior workout experience, but he made the process enjoyable and highly effective. His constant motivation and attention to detail have helped me achieve noticeable progress. The gym itself is well-maintained with top-notch equipment, making every session productive. If you’re thinking about joining, I can confidently say it’s a great choice!

featured_reviews.name: Minal Chimankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Joining the gym for the first time in my life was a daunting thought, but it turned out to be one of the best decisions, thanks to my personal trainer, Prathamesh Sir. He has been an incredible guide throughout my gym journey. His attention to detail in correcting my posture, ensuring proper form, and keeping workouts fresh with new variations has made my fitness experience not just effective but also enjoyable.

The gym itself is very well-equipped, and the atmosphere is welcoming. All the trainers here are friendly, approachable, and always ready to help. If you’re looking for a gym where you’ll feel supported and motivated, I highly recommend this place—and a huge shoutout to Prathamesh Sir for being such an amazing trainer!

featured_reviews.name: Sushil Birkar
featured_reviews.review_text: The key take away from this Gym is its owner Vaibhav and gym instructors who guide you on your daily excercise routine as well as recommend some diets. Overall the gym has good ambience, setup and equipments and the  cross fit setup is also cool for people who are looking for rigirous exercise .  Of all the gyms in the area this  surely  provides  value for money. Do try it once.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Bari
featured_reviews.review_text:
No nonsense and a prefect set of equipments for a good workout.
Amazing knowledgeable trainers to guide support and motivate.
Perfect mix of bright and neon lighting.

featured_reviews.name: Lalit Sathe
featured_reviews.review_text: Vaibhav sir and Sandesh Sir You have taken me to the next level! I am thrilled with the varied routines you have developed for me. You keep me interested and motivated, and I love the improvement in my body. I look forward to reaching new heights together. Thank you for taking me on this journey. I think Triangular Fitness Studio is the best gym in Borivali and proper covid guidelines are maintained in this gym.

featured_reviews.name: Rutvi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: I've been a member of this gym for just two weeks, but the progress I've made in my strength and fitness has been remarkable. Training under sandesh sir has been a game-changer; as someone who had never worked out before, he has made working out fun and effective for me. His encouragement and dedication push me to improve every day. The gym is fully equipped and well maintained, If you're considering joining, I highly recommend it!
